issues.title: Mismatched URL field styling
issues.description: The link inside the input element renders in an inverted black box with sharp corners, causing irregular nested padding and visual inconsistency.
issues.evidence: Black rectangular background wrapping the URL text inside the rounded input container.
issues.suggestion: Use standard input text styling with consistent padding and background tokens.
issues.triageNote: Verified: Radix FocusScope auto-focus select()s the first tabbable input on open (probe showed selection 0..28 on the read-only link field); with ui:input's selection:bg-primary the whole URL painted as an inverted near-black block. Fixed in dialog.tsx by collapsing the auto-selection (focus kept) in a composed onOpenAutoFocus guard.

issues.title: Input text clipped
issues.description: The memo name text field clips overflowing string content at its right edge without internal padding or truncation indicators.
issues.evidence: The text '(trimme' cuts off abruptly against the inner right border of the input container.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper right padding and text truncation styles to the text input.
issues.triageNote: Native <input> behavior: the 55-char default value is slightly wider than the field and clips without ellipsis (inputs never ellipsize; value is scrollable/selectable); px-3 padding exists in ui:input. Nothing defective in dialog.tsx (auto-select that also painted the value dark is now collapsed by the pair-019 fix).

issues.title: Low contrast metadata text
issues.description: Secondary monospace description text in pricing cards lacks sufficient contrast against the white surface.
issues.evidence: Text reading 'liquid glass surface material...' is faint light gray on white background.
issues.suggestion: Increase font weight or darken text color to meet contrast thresholds.
issues.triageNote: The faint 'liquid glass surface / material ...' caption is rendered by ds:GlassRefraction (text-neutral-500 / text-neutral-400 in src/components/ds/GlassRefraction/GlassRefraction.tsx) inside the dialog's pricing cards — root cause is outside ui:dialog's files; belongs to the ds:GlassRefraction owner.

issues.title: Close button not mirrored for RTL
issues.description: The dialog dismiss icon remains anchored to the top right.
issues.evidence: The 'X' icon sits at the top right of the dialog container.
issues.suggestion: Reposition the close button to the top left corner for RTL layouts.
issues.triageNote: Real: built-in close button used physical right-4 so it stayed top-right under dir=rtl. Fixed to logical end-4 (plus sm:text-left -> sm:text-start in DialogHeader); verified mirrored (16px from left edge in RTL) and re-audit no longer flags it.
